title: Coherent diagrams for the fixed geometric overlap object data
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRingCat a diagram with colimit cocone c, i≤j, and t:Z→Spec(R_i) locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume shared derived categories for all schemes and localized-open sites [def-pc-derived-category]. Put Yj=Z×Spec(R_j), X=Z×Spec(c.pt) and gj:X→Yj. Let U,V be compact opens covering Yj, A and B perfect objects on U and V, E in D(X), and phiU and phiV the supplied isomorphisms of their limit pullbacks with exact restrictions of E [def-pc-perfect-overlap-hom-continuity-data]. Set W=(U intersection V).toScheme, s=W.ι followed by Yj→Spec(R_j), and objects(false)=L(W→U)*A, objects(true)=L(W→V)*B [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Use the explicitly constructed finite-stage and apex equivalences, stage and apex object isomorphisms sigma and rho, actual transition pullback Hk=overlapLimitTransition, and its fixed composition comparison chi=overlapLimitBaseComparison [def-pc-perfect-overlap-stage-equivalence]. There are comparison data at every k≥j of perfectOverlapComparisonDataType [def-pc-perfect-overlap-hom-continuity-data], and a natural comparison eta:HWk followed by apexEquiv ≅ stageEquiv(k) followed by Hk. For each Boolean object, apexEquiv(psi).hom followed by rho and chi equals eta on that stage object followed by Hk of sigma. Here psi is exactly the prescribed gamma-theta-tau composite in the comparison data. This statement asks only for coherent diagrams and their compatibility with the fixed object data. No equivalence, object isomorphism, transition functor or comparison chi remains to construct; no Hom pin, Hom continuity or Hom equivalence is asserted.

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed perfectOverlapCanonicalComparisonFamily from the single-stage comparison module. This gives the prescribed family itself, rather than an independently chosen family from its nonemptiness theorem.

Apply perfect_overlap_object_realization_core_of_data to this canonical family, supplying its canonicality equation by reflexivity. This provides all seven fields of the core, with the exact fixed stage and apex equivalences and prescribed object pin.

Package the canonical family together with a core from the proved nonemptiness result into the required dependent pair. The obsolete hstage argument is not applied to the adopted source core proposition, which already has type Prop after hij; proof irrelevance identifies hstage with the trivial witness used by that proposition.

theorem perfect_overlap_object_realization_core_data
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t] [QuasiCompact t] [QuasiSeparated t]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hstage : ∀ (U V : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Opens),
      ∃ k : I, j ≤ k)
    : perfectOverlapObjectRealizationCoreStatement R c hc i Z t j hij
